AccessOut.description: Whether the gate is on and whether this browser is through it.
AccessOut.title: AccessOut

BatchValue.description: What a batch extracted for one document and field: the first finding whose citation verified, or why there is none.
BatchValue.title: BatchValue

CandidateOut.description: A section handed to the model, by the label it cites.
CandidateOut.title: CandidateOut

CitationRecordOut.description: What the verifier did across every run where the model answered, counted from the records.
CitationRecordOut.title: CitationRecordOut

CoverageOut.description: What the reading did with one part of the file: read, accepted, excluded, partial, omitted, absent or unknown.
CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut

CoverageReport.description:
A reading's coverage with its provenance. persisted: recorded by the reading at upload. reconstructed: computed later
from the stored bytes under the same reader version; the same facts, not captured at the time.
CoverageReport.title: CoverageReport

ExplanationCandidate.description: A section retrieval handed to the model, in rank order, with the ContextSlice of it the prompt carried.
ExplanationCandidate.title: ExplanationCandidate

ExplanationReconstruction.description: The exact model input, rebuilt from the record and checked against the hash the checking stage wrote.
ExplanationReconstruction.title: ExplanationReconstruction

GoldenRunOut.description: One golden under one prompt version: the run found by fingerprint and the verdict code gave it.
GoldenRunOut.title: GoldenRunOut

ModelProposal.description: What the model proposed, in its own words, parsed from the stored raw output; correlated to a finding by ordinal.
ModelProposal.title: ModelProposal

RecordedPolicyEvaluation.description: The status as it was recorded when the run finished, with its source and its sentence. Nothing re-derived.
RecordedPolicyEvaluation.title: RecordedPolicyEvaluation

ReviewOut.description: A person's current decision on a finding; absent when unreviewed or cleared.
ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut

SourceMatch.description: What the verifier established for one proposed quote: where it is in the stored text, if anywhere.
SourceMatch.title: SourceMatch

TrustDiffOut.description: What a revised document does to a run's findings. The run and its findings are not changed by asking.
TrustDiffOut.title: TrustDiffOut

TrustManifestOut.description: Why a run's findings are trusted, as of the document the run read. Derived from the record; never stored.
TrustManifestOut.title: TrustManifestOut

TrustObligationOut.description: One thing a finding needs in order to be relied on, answered on its own, with what the answer depends on.
TrustObligationOut.title: TrustObligationOut

get.description:
Whether the gate is on and whether this browser is through it. Open to everyone: it is how the page knows
to ask for an invite, and it says nothing else.

post.description: Exchange an invite for a session. The invite may be the bare token or the whole link it came in.

get.description: One row per document and field: the value, its status, the citation and how it was located, and the run.
This workspace's documents and the curated ones; the counts beside each are of runs it may read.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Documents Get

post.description: 201 with a document new to this workspace, or 200 with the one it already holds that has exactly these bytes.
Say that this document is the version after another. 201 when the statement is new, 200 when it was already made.

get.description: The line of versions this document belongs to in this workspace, oldest first; empty when it is in none.

schema.title: Response Document Versions Api Documents  Document Id  Versions Get

get.description:
How often the model's quotes were found, by which method, and how often a finding was withheld, over the runs
this workspace may read: its own and the curated record.
Structural families among the labeled corpus documents at a threshold, with the evaluation against the labels.
The golden set with each golden's run and verdict per prompt version, and the latest comparison.
Findings of the runs this workspace may read: its own and the curated ones.

schema.title: Response List Findings Api Findings Get

post.description:
Record a person's decision. 201 when it changed the state, 200 when it repeated it; `cleared` undoes. With the gate
on, the invite's subject is recorded beside the typed name; the name is what the browser sent and is not an identity.
201 with a new guidance record in this workspace, or 200 with the one it may already use that holds these words.

get.description:
Open to everyone, because the supervisor and the page ask before anyone has entered. Past the gate it names
the model and its state; before it, only whether the workbench is up and that the gate is on.

post.description:
201 with a memo for the run's current review state, or 200 with the one already written under it. A review
after a memo makes the next request write a new memo; the earlier one is kept as it was.

get.description: This workspace's runs and the curated ones, newest first, the latest 200.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Runs Get

post.description: 202 with a new run, or 200 with this workspace's running or completed run that already has these inputs.

get.description:
Stage transitions only. Replays what already happened, then streams until the run ends, by this process's
bus or, at the latest, one heartbeat after the record says it ended.
A zip with the original bytes, the canonical sections, the run record, every located span and a stdlib verify.py.

Why this answer: what was read, what retrieval chose, the exact model input, the model's proposal, each
SourceMatch and the recorded policy evaluation, all from the record. Read-only; nothing is recomputed as fact.

What each finding of a finished run stands on: its quotes, whether each stands once, the typed values they
state, and the reader and rules it was made under.

What a later version of the document does to this run's findings: which are stale and why, which were
established again, which the revision did not reach. Nothing is changed by asking.
